name: Word Frequency Counter
summary: Count how often each word appears, with ranks, percentages, and CSV export — in your browser.
description: Paste text to see a ranked word-frequency table. Toggle case sensitivity, stop-word filtering, minimum length, sort order, and top-N. Copy results as CSV. Complements the Keyword Density Checker with a general-purpose frequency list.

faqs.question: How is this different from Keyword Density?
faqs.answer: Keyword Density is SEO-oriented (density %, focus keywords). Word Frequency is a general ranked list of every word with counts and CSV export.

faqs.question: What counts as a word?
faqs.answer: Sequences of letters, digits, apostrophes, and hyphens (e.g. don’t, well-known).

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Counting runs entirely in your browser.
